ValidationRule.description: If Customer is Business Owner, then Business Name, Business Address and Business Industry is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (TEXT( Employment_Status__c ) = 'Business Owner' && (ISBLANK( Business_Name__c ) || ISBLANK( Business_Address__c ) || TEXT(Business_Industry__c )=''))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Customer is Business Owner, then Business Name, Business Address and Business Industry is mandatory
